faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about KingdomScout.
faq.q1: How does the AI determine a deal is 'great'?
faq.a1: Our algorithm compares the listing price against market averages for similar properties in the same neighborhood. Deals priced 15% or more below market are flagged as 'great deals', while those 10-15% below are flagged as 'good deals'. We also factor in potential rental yield and time on market.
faq.q2: How often is the data updated?
faq.a2: Our system scans every 4 hours, monitoring aqar.fm for new listings across all the cities we cover.
faq.q3: Can I get alerts for specific criteria?
faq.a3: Yes! You can create a free account and set up saved searches with custom filters (city, neighborhood, price range, property type, etc.) and receive email or Telegram alerts when new matching deals are found.
faq.a4: We extract contact information directly from the source listings. While we validate phone number formats, we recommend verifying details before making any commitments.
faq.a5: We currently cover all major Saudi cities including Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, Khobar, Taif, Abha, Khamis Mushait, Buraidah, Tabuk, Hail, Najran, Jubail, and Qatif.
faq.a6: Yes! KingdomScout is 100% free. All features are available to everyone with no subscription fees.
